description: an http server emits request at the head and streams the body, as Node 22: an answer before the body, then the rest dumped and the next request served, a Content-Length and a chunked upload read as they arrive with its trailers, Expect 100-continue answered with 100 Continue or given to checkContinue, an unmet expectation 417 or checkExpectation, a client gone mid-body 400 with aborted and the request error, and a client flushHeaders that sends the head before end
